title: Semantic claim verification: three questions apart, no more than the ledger says, an opinion granted nothing
note: Section 6.3 (D-2026-173). Each mutation lets the grammar read more than the sentence says, weighs evidence it should not (another model's, another unit's, a withdrawn record's, only what was cited), turns doubt or a failed checker into support, or grants an assessed or badly cited claim the property. tests/test_claim_check.py holds each, against real authority records read into the research ledger.

mutations.name: CC1_a_rider_is_read_as_part_of_the_claim
mutations.rationale: 6.3: 'below 350 K, so the panel is safe' is judged as 'below 350 K'

mutations.name: CC2_below_is_read_as_at_most
mutations.rationale: 6.3: a strict claim is read as a weaker one

mutations.name: CC3_another_model_s_output_counts
mutations.find:
usable = [o for o in observations
              if o.get("model_id") == claim.model_id
              and claim.quantity
mutations.replace:
usable = [o for o in observations
              if claim.quantity
mutations.rationale: 6.3: a run of one model is read as evidence about another

mutations.name: CC4_units_are_not_compared
mutations.rationale: 6.3: a value in one unit is compared with a number claimed in another

mutations.name: CC5_equality_ignores_resolution
mutations.find: each.add("SUPPORTED" if lo <= claim.value <= hi else "REFUTED")
mutations.rationale: 6.3: a value within an output's resolution is called a contradiction

mutations.name: CC6_disagreement_is_not_reported
mutations.rationale: 6.3: runs that disagree read as whichever verdict comes next

mutations.name: CC7_the_doubtful_case_is_support
mutations.find:
return (Verdict.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE,
            "an output's resolution straddles the claimed value", used)
mutations.replace:
return (Verdict.SUPPORTED,
            "an output's resolution straddles the claimed value", used)
mutations.rationale: 6.3: a value the resolution cannot decide is called support

mutations.name: CC8_only_what_the_claim_cites_is_weighed
mutations.replace:
verdict, why, used = judge(structured, [o for o in admitted
                                                if o['observation_id'] in cites])
mutations.rationale: 6.3: a claim avoids a contradicting run by not citing it

mutations.name: CC9_a_checker_overrules_the_grammar
mutations.find:
if structured is not None:
        verdict, why, used = judge(structured, admitted)
mutations.replace:
if structured is not None and checker is None:
        verdict, why, used = judge(structured, admitted)
mutations.rationale: 6.3: an opinion replaces a deterministic verdict

mutations.name: CC10_an_opinion_is_established
mutations.find:
if basis is Basis.DETERMINISTIC and verdict is Verdict.SUPPORTED and \
            citation == "INTACT":
        label = establish(label, Property.SEMANTICALLY_SUPPORTED,
                          check=JUDGE,
mutations.replace:
if verdict is Verdict.SUPPORTED and \
            citation == "INTACT":
        label = establish(label, Property.SEMANTICALLY_SUPPORTED,
                          check=JUDGE,
mutations.rationale: 6.3: a checker's SUPPORTED is granted the property

mutations.name: CC11_a_broken_citation_does_not_matter
mutations.find:
if basis is Basis.DETERMINISTIC and verdict is Verdict.SUPPORTED and \
            citation == "INTACT":
mutations.replace: if basis is Basis.DETERMINISTIC and verdict is Verdict.SUPPORTED:
mutations.rationale: 6.3: a claim with a forged citation, or none, would be established; the registry's requirement (CITED_BYTES_VERIFY first) refuses it as well

mutations.name: CC12_altered_bytes_are_not_rehashed
mutations.rationale: 6.3: bytes changed on disk after observation still count as cited

mutations.name: CC13_a_citation_to_nothing_is_intact
mutations.rationale: 6.3: a citation of an observation that does not exist passes

mutations.name: CC14_a_withdrawn_source_is_admitted
mutations.find:
if Standing(currency["standing"]) not in USABLE:
        return
mutations.rationale: 6.3: an observation whose record no longer stands is weighed

mutations.name: CC15_a_lost_admission_is_not_read
mutations.rationale: 6.3: a scientific result whose admission no longer holds here is weighed

mutations.name: CC16_a_failed_checker_is_a_verdict
mutations.find: return Verdict.UNVERIFIABLE, f"the checker gave no usable answer " \
mutations.replace: return Verdict.SUPPORTED, f"the checker gave no usable answer " \
mutations.rationale: 6.3: a checker that answered nothing is read as support
